question: With a free GNews key and a request counter at zero: does the 101st request of one UTC day answer 403, does the second request inside one second answer 429, which headers do those two answers carry (Retry-After or a rate-limit header), and how many characters does the content field hold on a Free plan response?
why: each value needs a free key, which needs an email sign-up that only the operator can make; the error-handling page, the FAQ, the OpenAPI specification and the official client libraries state the 403 and the 429, no first-party page states the excerpt length (sample responses show 250 characters before a '... [N chars]' marker, other third-party pages state 200, 256 and 260 characters without a sample), and four keyless requests sent inside half a second all answered 400, none 429
